Huperzia nutans Nodding Clubmoss View Profile FWS Focus overview characteristics geography timeline information & media contact Overview Huperzia nutans, a member of the Lycopodiaceae (club moss) family, is a clumped club moss that is terrestrial or epiphytic up to 50 cm (20 in) tall. A mature plant consists of a cluster of several erect stems arising from the plants base. The stems may be unbranched, once-forked, or twice-forked. The sterile leaves are lanceolate, 13 to 20 mm (0.5 to 0.8 in) long and 2 to 3.5 mm (0.08 to 0.14 in) wide and are arranged in six ranks of leaves along the stem. The strobili (sporangia-bearing structures densely aggregated along a stem) arise from the ends of all mature branches, curve downward, and are simple, or are branched once or twice. The sterile leaves on the stems gradually transition into the smaller fertile leaves on the strobili. The fertile leaves measure 10 to 20 mm (0.4 to 0.8 in) long and 1.5 to 2.5 mm (0.06 to 0.1 in) wide and bear reproductive sporangia in the axils. Dirk Renckhoff, Alamy Stock Photo TRAVEL This ancient city in Sardinia was home to pirates—and is an archaeology lover’s dream Nora doesn’t have the name recognition—or crowds—of Pompeii. But the well-preserved coastal settlement offers travelers a rare glimpse into the lives of the pirates, Vandals, Romans, Phoenicians, and Carthaginians who once laid claim to it. By Hannah Singleton Published February 10, 2026 Perched at the edge of a narrow peninsula in southern Sardinia , the ancient city of Nora is exposed to the elements. Wind, sun, salty air, and for centuries, even pirates. From every vantage point of the port city, residents and visitors can take in views of the Mediterranean Sea, which made Nora a thriving trade hub during the 8th century B.C. Nora doesn’t have the name recognition, impressive towering structures, or crowds of tourists like Pompeii or Ephesus. The ancient city, now a significant archaeological site, offers history buffs a rare glimpse of over 1,500 years of life in the ancient Sardinian city—a 43-minute drive from Cagliari. The Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library is set to open in July 2026 outside Medora, North Dakota. Photograph by Image Professionals GmbH, Alamy Stock Photo By Stephanie Pearson Published October 21, 2025 Theodore Roosevelt first traveled to the Badlands on a hunting trip in 1883. He was so taken by the otherworldly landscape of pastel buttes, trilling meadowlarks, and disappearing bison, that he returned in 1884 to grieve the simultaneous deaths of his wife and mother, raising cattle and working on the wild frontier for almost three years. Its “desolate, grim beauty” so changed Roosevelt that he famously wrote, “I would not have been president had it not been for my experience in North Dakota .” Opening on July 4, 2026, the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library celebrates the Badlands as much as it does the 26th president. pages.text: Northern Ireland 1-0 Ukraine: The 'manager's dream' who has put NI one game from history - BBC Sport Image source, Press Eye Image caption, Terry Devlin scored his first Northern Ireland goal against Ukraine By Andy Gray BBC Sport NI Journalist Published 14 November 2026 It was a moment that Northern Ireland needed. When Terry Devlin picked the ball up on the edge of the area in the 68th minute against Ukraine there was only one thought in his mind. And when the ball flew into the corner Windsor Park erupted at another highlight of a Nations League campaign that has been a real feel-good story so far. Heading into Saturday's game they had yet to concede a goal, but the one thing they had lacked was a home win - or even a home goal - after drawing blanks in stalemates with Hungary and Georgia in Belfast. They had already come close when Jamie Donley slotted home in the first half but the forward had strayed offside, leaving the moment the hosts had been waiting for to come through Devlin's superb winner. It leaves Northern Ireland's Nations League fate in their own hands, and a draw or better in Hungary would secure promotion to League A for the first time. For Northern Ireland boss Michael O'Neill, it was a huge moment from a player who he said is "a bit of a dream" to manage. "Terry's a great lad. He deserves everything he'll get from the game and he's one of those lads that maximises what he has," O'Neill said about the 23-year-old Portsmouth defender. L. 104-191). HIPAA section 421 makes changes, described below, to three areas in the continuation coverage rules applicable to group health plans under the Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act of 1985 (COBRA), as amended. These three areas relate to the disability extension, the definition of qualified beneficiary and the duration of COBRA continuation coverage. These changes are effective beginning January 1, 1997, regardless of when the event occurs that entitles an individual to COBRA continuation coverage. Section 421(e) of HIPAA requires group health plans that are subject to COBRA to notify, by November 1, 1996, individuals who have elected COBRA continuation coverage of these changes. The department is issuing this release to apprise employers and plan administrators of the changes in the continuation coverage rules made by HIPAA and to inform them of their obligation under HIPAA to notify qualified beneficiaries of such changes. pages.text: Notre communauté - Internet Society Notre communauté Notre communauté Notre vaste et diverse communauté de plus de 150 000 bénévoles et 80 organisations apporte de véritables changements dans le monde entier. Qui compose notre communauté ? Membres individuels Nos membres individuels jouent un rôle essentiel dans la mise en œuvre de notre vision en contribuant à des projets menés par la communauté. Ils participent à des événements, des campagnes de plaidoyer et des initiatives d’autonomisation. Chapitres Nos chapitres accomplissent un travail remarquable (sur six continents !) pour répondre aux besoins de leurs communautés. Toute personne membre individuelle ou membre d’un chapitre peut rejoindre un SIG ou un SG. pages.text: Notre travail - Internet Society Notre travail Notre travail Œuvrer pour un Internet fiable et communautaire, accessible à tout le monde. Internet est une force transformatrice. Mais tout le monde n’en bénéficie pas de la même manière. Environ 2 milliards de personnes n’ont toujours pas accès à Internet. Et, de plus en plus, notre sécurité en ligne est mise en péril par le manque de confiance quant au contrôle de nos informations personnelles. Les enjeux n’ont jamais été aussi importants. C’est pourquoi nous nous associons aux communautés pour aider chacun à surmonter ses obstacles spécifiques à la connectivité, qu’ils soient géographiques, techniques, réglementaires ou financiers. Dans le cadre de notre Stratégie 2030, nous nous concentrons sur deux défis mondiaux majeurs auxquels Internet est confronté : Manque de confiance envers Internet . Parce que tout le monde mérite une expérience Internet sûre, sécurisée et respectueuse de sa vie privée. Inégalités mondiales . Parce que les personnes du monde entier doivent avoir accès à un Internet abordable, fiable et résilient. Découvrez nos activités pour l’année à venir dans notre Plan d’action 2026 .
